# Hivemind Intelligence

https://hivemindintelligence.com/

> Hivemind installs private, on-premise AI infrastructure inside small licensed practices (law, medical, dental, therapy). Documents are processed on hardware in the practice's own office, and a person approves every client-facing message. Based in Coral Gables, Florida. Founder: Kevin Miller.

## Offer (prices as of November 2026)

- AI Practice Audit: $1,500 flat, delivered in 7 days. Written findings the practice keeps whether or not it hires Hivemind.
- Install: $9,000 to $50,000, scoped on workflow complexity and privacy requirements, including any custom training of local models. Hardware in the office, private models, top workflows, a written AI usage policy, staff training.
- Manage: from $2,000 a month. Monitoring, hardware refresh, model updates, one new workflow every quarter. Cancel anytime.
